events.title: Tencent brings WePocketModel to Apple silicon with MLX
events.title_zh: Tencent 用 MLX 把 WePocketModel 带到 Apple silicon
events.summary: Tencent released MLX builds of the 2B and 4B WePocketModel family for Apple silicon. One shared multimodal backbone handles generation, text-image embeddings and structured decisions, with Apache-2.0 weights and a self-contained runtime. The 4B build reports 4.25 GiB peak memory and 30.6 tok/s under 4-bit quantization on an M3 Pro, but all quality and speed results are publisher-run.
events.summary_en: Tencent released MLX builds of the 2B and 4B WePocketModel family for Apple silicon. One shared multimodal backbone handles generation, text-image embeddings and structured decisions, with Apache-2.0 weights and a self-contained runtime. The 4B build reports 4.25 GiB peak memory and 30.6 tok/s under 4-bit quantization on an M3 Pro, but all quality and speed results are publisher-run.
events.summary_zh: Tencent 发布 WePocketModel 2B 与 4B 的 MLX 版本，可在 Apple silicon 上运行。一个共享多模态骨干同时负责生成、图文嵌入与结构化决策，权重采用 Apache-2.0，并附带独立 runtime。发布方称 4B 的 4-bit 版本在 M3 Pro 上峰值占用 4.25 GiB、解码 30.6 tok/s，但质量和速度都尚无独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: Teams building private local apps on Macs can test one small model for multimodal RAG, generation and low-risk decision gates instead of loading separate specialist models.
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams building private local apps on Macs can test one small model for multimodal RAG, generation and low-risk decision gates instead of loading separate specialist models.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对在 Mac 上做私有本地应用的团队来说，可以用一个小模型同时试验多模态 RAG、生成和低风险决策，不必常驻多套专用模型。

technical_details.capabilities: Text/image generation, multimodal embeddings with 64-2048 MRL dimensions, structured choice/score/binary decisions
technical_details.publisher_4b_m3_pro: BF16 8.99 GiB peak and 13.9 tok/s; 4-bit 4.25 GiB peak and 30.6 tok/s
technical_details.publisher_2b_m3_pro: BF16 4.49 GiB peak and 28.8 tok/s; 4-bit 2.76 GiB peak and 55.8 tok/s
technical_details.availability: Downloadable MLX weights with self-contained runtime; no hosted API
technical_details.time_basis: Hugging Face repositories created at 2026-11-25T06:25:00Z and 06:25:21Z

technical_details_zh.模型: 2B 与 4B MLX 版本；基于 Qwen3.5
technical_details_zh.能力: 文本/图像生成；64-2048 维 MRL 多模态嵌入；choice/score/二元结构化决策
technical_details_zh.发布方 4B M3 Pro: BF16 峰值 8.99 GiB、13.9 tok/s；4-bit 峰值 4.25 GiB、30.6 tok/s
technical_details_zh.发布方 2B M3 Pro: BF16 峰值 4.49 GiB、28.8 tok/s；4-bit 峰值 2.76 GiB、55.8 tok/s
technical_details_zh.可用性: MLX 权重与独立 runtime 可下载；没有托管 API
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 两个 Hugging Face 仓库创建于 2026-11-25T06:25:00Z 与 06:25:21Z

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在一台 M 系列 Mac 上跑 20 个图文检索、生成和决策样本，记录质量、内存、首 token 与吞吐。
